my onedrive files are not auto syncing
COMMUNITY ANSWERIf you don’t see it, click the ^ arrow to show hidden icons and look for it there. Check what OneDrive is saying: Click the cloud icon once. One drive not syncing
COMMUNITY ANSWERRefresh File Explorer and check if the syncing issue persists. Change the Startup type back to Automatic (Delayed Start) and rebuild the index by accessing Indexing Options from the Start menu, selecting Advanced, and then clicking on Rebuild. Reset OneDrive: If the problem continues, resetting OneDrive might help.
